Phat hien 11 muc no ky thuat qua doc code, xem docs/TECHNICAL_DEBT.md - dang chu y nhat: bug ROLES tinh sai trong config.js, upload.routes.js thieu xac thuc (giong TK-HATU), 2 bug logic trong device.routes.js.

steps.name: BUILD
steps.message: docker build -t dieuphoimm-backend-baseline ./WebApp/Backend PASS that (2026-08-24). npm ci bao 65 vulnerabilities (4 low/35 moderate/22 high/4 critical) - xem TECHNICAL_DEBT muc 11.

steps.name: TEST
steps.message: docker run --entrypoint sh ... npm test -> jest: 'No tests found, exiting with code 1'. Dung nhu du doan: 0 file test that trong Backend (jest cai san nhung chua ai viet test). Frontend cung 0 test file (react-scripts test co san nhung khong co gi de chay). Day la hien trang that, chua sua trong onboarding.

steps.name: PREVIEW
